landing.metaTitle: Booking software for DJ and band agencies
landing.metaDescription: Inquiries, quotes, artists and payments in one place. With your own booking page, iDEAL and automatic artist payouts.
landing.title: From inquiry to payout, without the spreadsheets
landing.intro: StageDesk gives your agency one place for inquiries, quotes, planning, artists and payments. Your customers book through your own page; your artists get paid automatically after the party.
landing.previewLabel: Example of the booking overview in StageDesk
landing.featuresIntro: Built around how agencies actually work: a lot of inquiries, a handful of artists, and every weekend full.
landing.feature_inquiriesBody: Every agency gets a booking page and a form for its own website. Inquiries land in your queue straight away.
landing.feature_quotesBody: Lines from your service catalogue, VAT done right, a deposit and an expiry date. Customers accept with one click.
landing.feature_planningBody: A calendar of every event, artist availability, and reminders before quotes expire and events start.
landing.feature_artistsBody: Ask an artist, they accept in the app and get the full brief. Share artists with partner agencies.
landing.feature_paymentsBody: Customers pay by iDEAL or card. After the event the artist's share and yours are paid out automatically.
landing.feature_messagesBody: Messages per booking with the customer and the artist, live notifications, and email when it matters.
landing.moneyTitle: Money that arrives where it should
landing.moneyIntro: No more transferring artist fees by hand. The split is agreed when the customer accepts, and paid out after the event.
landing.money1: The customer pays the deposit and balance online, with iDEAL or card.
landing.money2: After the event, and a short wait for disputes, StageDesk splits the payment.
landing.money3: The artist's share goes to the artist; the rest goes to your agency.
landing.splitNote: With the current platform fee and a 40% artist share, before Stripe's processing fee.
landing.pricingIntro: Plans from {price} a month. Try everything free for {days} days, no card needed.
landing.pricingIntroNoPlans: Plans for every size of agency.
landing.faq1Q: Do my customers need an account?
landing.faq1A: No. They sign in with a code we email them, and only to see their event, quote and payments.
landing.faq2Q: Can I keep using bank transfers?
landing.faq2A: Yes. You can record offline payments in the booking. Online payments are optional.
landing.faq3A: With online payments, the artist connects a Stripe account once and receives their share automatically after each event. Otherwise you pay them as you do now, and StageDesk shows what's still owed.
landing.faq4Q: Is my data stored in the EU?
landing.faq4A: Yes. StageDesk runs on servers in the EU, and we sign a data processing agreement with every agency.
landing.faq5A: Yes. You can cancel your subscription whenever you like; it stops at the end of the period you've paid for.
landing.waitlistIntro: StageDesk opens soon. Leave your email and we'll let you know.
landing.closingIntro: Set up your agency in an afternoon. Free to try.

featuresPage.title: Everything from first inquiry to final payout
featuresPage.intro: StageDesk follows a booking from start to finish, and keeps your agency, your artists and your customers in step.

bookingPage.title: Booking page and website form
bookingPage.body: A page per agency where customers ask for a quote, plus a form for your own website.
bookingPage.p1: The form adapts to the event: weddings ask about the ceremony.
bookingPage.p2: Show your artists with photos, genres and videos.
bookingPage.p3: Spam protection without puzzles for your customer.
bookingPage.p4: Search-engine friendly, so your page can be found.

quotes.body: Quotes from your service catalogue, with versions, VAT and a deposit.
quotes.p1: Accepting with one click, or on the customer's behalf.
quotes.p3: Quote and invoice as PDF with your logo.

planning.body: Every booking moves through clear steps, from inquiry to settled.
planning.p1: Calendar with all events of the month.
planning.p3: Reminders 7 days and 1 day before an event.

artists.title: Artists
artists.body: Your artists in one place, and in the app themselves.
artists.p1: Artists accept or decline requests in the app.

payments.title: Payments and payouts
payments.body: Online payments with iDEAL and cards, through Stripe.
payments.p1: Deposit and balance paid online or recorded offline.
payments.p2: Automatic split after the event: artist, agency, platform.

communication.p1: A conversation per booking with the customer and with the artist.

forAgencies.title: Less admin, more weekends booked
forAgencies.intro: StageDesk takes the repetitive work off your hands, so you can spend your time on customers and artists.

forAgencies.fix1Body: Your booking page and website form send everything to the same place, with the details you need to quote.
forAgencies.fix2Body: Choose lines, VAT and deposit; the customer accepts online. New version? The customer always sees the latest.
forAgencies.fix3Body: Ask an artist for a gig; they accept with the full brief. Declined? Ask the next one straight away.
forAgencies.fix4Body: With online payments, the artist's share and yours are paid out automatically after the event.
forAgencies.closingBody: Plans for small and large agencies, all with a free trial.

forArtists.title: Your gigs, your brief, your earnings
forArtists.intro: Play for an agency that uses StageDesk? Then you have everything for your gigs in one app.
forArtists.pain1: Gig details spread over emails and chats
forArtists.fix1Body: Times, venue, guest count, playlist, do's and don'ts: everything in one place, also on your phone.
forArtists.pain2: Not knowing which requests are still open
forArtists.fix2: Accept or decline in one tap
forArtists.fix2Body: New requests appear at the top. Answer them, and the agency knows straight away.
forArtists.fix3Body: Connect a Stripe account once and receive your share after every event paid online.
forArtists.pain4: Losing track of what you earned
forArtists.fix4Body: See what you earned, what's paid out and what's coming, per booking.
forArtists.closingBody: Artists join through their agency: ask them to invite you. Run your own agency? Start a free trial.
